Rules.Alignment:
The classic Evil-Neutral-Good alignments, with outliers of Chaotic(evil) and Lawful(good) who will not cooperate.
Notice Chaotic-good are included within Good, and Lawful-evil are within Evil.
Rules.Caste:
Most partons are divided into 5 castes in ascending order. They may only associate with castes of their own and adjacent to their own.

Underclass - Commoner - Noble - Aristocrat - Royalty.
The Trait Snob prevents association with a lower caste.
The caste Omni is special and reserved for beings that don't precieve castes.

Outcast means the patron fell 2 castes below what he was. Eg: An Outcast_Noble is formerly known to be a Noble but now is an Underclass.
Poser means the patron imposes to be 2 castes above what they are. Eg: A Poser_Noble is formerly known to be an Underclass.

Precious Metals.Copper: Mostly trades as raw bullions. Used in industry for producing liquid containers, metal coating for finished products, and mixed in tougher alloys.
Precious Metals.Silver: Valueable enough to be minted in coins and traded bearing the king's crest. It's size and weight is almost identical to 3 modern standard US quarters.
Precious Metals.Gold: An overvalued metal, its absense is spread due to the greed of vile draconian monsters who hide it in their caverns.
Precious Metals.Electrum: A precious alloy traded in tablet-like coins.

Inventory.Basics: Inventory can either be held in the guild stash, on characters, and in shared bag or baggage. Some items will be locked, meaning they can't be moved to a new position because they're private property of that character.
Inventory.Tarot Cards: Painted on leather backs, scattered around the land, you might find arcane magic painted on cards, just like magical scrolls. They come in two classes, Minor Arcana and Major Arcana, can be invoked to unleash their magic and consume the card. There's a rumor whomever gathers all the Major Arcana cards gets a wish as their reward.
